name: Joely Fisher
bio: Joely Fisher (born October 29, 1967) is an American actress best known for her work on television as Paige Clark on Ellen as well as Joy Stark in the Fox sitcom 'Til Death, and also on stage and in films. She is the daughter of actor singer Eddie Fisher and actress Connie Stevens, and half-sister of actress Carrie Fisher.
